title: Payment Gateway Outage Response
description: Payment processing system outage affecting transaction processing
immediate_actions: Declare P1 incident and activate incident commander
Assess impact on transaction processing volume
Activate payment processing failover if available
resolution_steps: Restart payment processing services following vendor procedures
Implement transaction queue processing if backlog exists
Coordinate with payment network partners for any issues
Apply database fixes or restart if needed
verification: Test payment processing with test transactions
Verify transaction processing rates return to normal
special_considerations: All suspected payment-data security incidents require immediate escalation
Do not modify transaction databases without approval from the VertexPay DBA team
Coordinate with compliance team for regulatory requirements
Maintain audit trail during incident resolution
